chunks: And from a letter of his (peace be upon him) to the people of Egypt, when he appointed al-Ashtar as their governor, may Allah have mercy on him.

key_terms.الْأَشْتَرُ: Al-Ashtar (Malik al-Ashtar), a prominent companion of Imam Ali
key_terms.رَحْمَةُ اللَّهِ: May Allah have mercy (a formula of blessing)

ai.seo_question: What is the context of Imam Ali's letter to Malik al-Ashtar?
ai.summary: This heading introduces the seminal 'Letter of Malik al-Ashtar,' a cornerstone of Shia political jurisprudence detailing Imam Ali’s (AS) administrative directives upon his appointment of Malik al-Ashtar as governor of Egypt. It serves as the preamble to a comprehensive manual on justice, emphasizing the ruler's duty to treat all subjects—whether Muslim or non-Muslim—with equity and compassion, thereby establishing the theological basis for Islamic governance.
